title: Access the NSW Building Certifiers' Portal
summary: This page provides information and access points for the NSW Building Certifiers' Portal, allowing registered certifiers to manage applications and registration details online.
who_can_apply: Must be a registered building certifier in NSW.
what_you_need: Access to the NSW Building Certifiers’ Portal (https://applications.fairtrading.nsw.gov.au/BDCPortal/Account/Login.aspx?ReturnUrl=/BDCPortal)
contact: For help with applications, access and online portal issues, contact the certifiers’ registration team by emailing certifierregistration@customerservice.nsw.gov.au.

faqs.q: How do I get help with the online portal or applications?
faqs.a: For help with applications, access, or online portal issues, contact the certifiers’ registration team by emailing certifierregistration@customerservice.nsw.gov.au.

faqs.q: What can I do using the Building Certifiers' Portal?
faqs.a: Through the portal, you can lodge applications, submit supporting documentation, view your application status, view registration details, and pay associated fees.

faqs.q: What types of applications can I submit?
faqs.a: Applications include individual certifier registrations, mutual recognition, variations of registration, body corporate (company) registrations, and voluntary surrender or suspension.
